# xcode theme inputs

Source: https://github.com/WhiteVermouth/XcodeTheme

Commit: `872a6123d8b37df525649c66ea99d16f27ea23fb`

License: Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE`). Exact upstream bytes and hashes are recorded in assets.tsv.

Original author fields are preserved. If absent, use upstream vendor credit: Zihan Ma.

- `XcodeLight.theme.json`: Studio Light (`xcode-light`); old names: Xcode Light
- `XcodeDark.theme.json`: Studio Dark (`xcode-dark`); old names: Xcode Dark
- `IslandsXcodeLight.theme.json`: excluded — Islands variant is outside the approved classic variant set.
- `IslandsXcodeDark.theme.json`: excluded — Islands variant is outside the approved classic variant set.

Studio overrides under overrides/ are Jasper-authored (not upstream files). Background/foreground/selection follow the editor colors; ANSI colors were selected locally to match the editor palette.
